summary: Comprehensive testing of AI-First Module Entry with Master Data Validation. All 20 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified AI prompt bars in all 4 modules (Buying, Selling, Manufacturing, Journal Entry), smart popup functionality with strict dropdowns, and master data validation. Old form buttons removed. Seeded data intact: 13+ POs, 9+ SOs, balanced TB.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all AI prompt features working in all 4 modules)

test_credentials: No authentication required - all endpoints are public
seed_data_creation: Created 1 PO (LANXESS India, RM-MDI) and 1 SO (L&T Construction, EP-1000) during backend testing. Total now 13+ POs, 9+ SOs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI-first module entry fully tested. All 4 modules (Buying, Selling, Manufacturing, Journal Entry) have ModuleAIPrompt component with inline AI prompt bar. Old dropdown forms removed. SmartFormPopup uses StrictDropdown for vendor/customer/item fields. Backend validates master data existence before creating PO/SO.

buying_module_ai_prompt.details: AI prompt bar visible at top of Purchase Orders tab. Old form button removed. Typed 'PO for 3000 KG MDI-200 from LANXESS India at 262/KG' → popup shows with 95% confidence, pre-filled vendor (LANXESS India), item (RM-MDI), qty (3000), rate (262), totals calculated.

selling_module_ai_prompt.details: AI prompt bar visible at top of Sales Orders tab. Typed 'SO for L&T Construction 1000 KG EP-1000 at 520/KG' → popup shows with 95% confidence, pre-filled customer (L&T Construction), item (EP-1000), qty (1000), rate (520), totals calculated.

manufacturing_module_ai_prompt.details: AI prompt bar visible at top of Manufacturing page. Typed 'Produce 2000 KG PU-C450' → popup shows with 95% confidence, pre-filled FG Item Code (PU-C450), Qty to Produce (2000), Cost Center, Planned Start/End dates.

journal_entry_module_ai_prompt.details: AI prompt bar visible at top of Journal Entries page. Typed 'Debit Utility Expense 50000, Credit Cash & Bank (HDFC Current) 50000' → popup shows with 95% confidence, pre-filled narration, journal lines with debit/credit, shows 'Balanced' status.

strict_dropdown_validation.details: SmartFormPopup uses StrictDropdown component for vendor/customer/item fields. Only values from master data are allowed in dropdowns. No free-text entry permitted.

backend_master_data_validation.details: POST /api/purchase/orders with non-existent vendor returns 400 error with 'not found in master data' message. POST /api/selling/sales-orders with non-existent customer returns 400 error. Same for invalid items.

ai_parse_prompt_api.details: POST /api/ai/parse-prompt correctly parses prompts for all intents (purchase_order, sales_order, work_order, journal_entry). Returns intent, confidence, summary, extracted data, missing fields, and master_data object with vendors/customers/items/cost_centers/ledgers lists.

seeded_data_integrity.details: 13+ POs (10 seeded + 3 test-created), 9+ SOs (8 seeded + 1 test-created), 12 vendors, 10 customers, 18 items. Trial Balance balanced.

global_ai_prompt_bar.details: Universal AI prompt bar visible at bottom center of all pages. Works alongside module-specific AI prompt bars.
